insights.summary: From Arihant's Bharat Connect compendium (September 2026 conference, published 5 October): management targets 3x revenue in three years from existing plants, with utilisation rising from 40-45% to 80%, an EBITDA margin of at least 22% and 30-40% gross margins. The ₹40 Cr injectables plant should start in October 2026 and break even in FY27, medical devices should grow at least 50% in FY27, receivable days should fall back to 100-120, and a cephalosporin unit is planned within 18-24 months on newly bought land. The note's revenue mix (exports 70%, Africa 50-60%) differs from the company's own deck.

what_changed.text: EBITDA margin at least 22%; gross margin 30-40%
Injectables plant from October 2026, break-even FY27
Medical devices to grow at least 50% in FY27
Cephalosporin unit within 18-24 months; later oncology, ARV and serum plants

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Management targets 3x top-line growth over the next 3 years from existing capacities

red_flags.text: Second-hand: a broker's summary, not a company filing.
Note says exports are 70% and Africa 50-60% of revenue; the company's May deck shows FY26 standalone revenue 49% domestic and Asia ~57%, Africa ~25%. One of them is wrong or uses a different base.
Receivable days rose to ~209 in FY26 (Screener) on Q4 tender execution and disruption.
Injectables plant funded with bank debt and promoter money; exports from it only by 2029.

watch_next: Medical devices growth vs at least 50%

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Pharma formulations, injectables, medical devices (IV cannulas, infusion and blood sets), cosmetics and wellness products
business_snapshot.customers: 100+ distributors across 20 supplied countries (46 with registrations); domestic tenders and private hospitals
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Per the note: exports 70% (direct 50%, merchant 20%), domestic 30%; Africa 50-60%, Latin America 30%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Registrations, moves into semi-regulated markets (Peru, Trinidad & Tobago, Panama), off-patent molecules, higher utilisation
